source.text: ወመንገለ፡ ዐረቡ፡ ለዝ፡ ካልእ፡ ደብር፡ ወይቴሐቶ፡ ሎቱ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ኑሐ፡ ወ*ቈላ፡ ታሕቱ፡ ማእከሎሙ፡ ወካልእት፡ ቈላ፡ ዕሙቅ፡ ወይቡስ፡ መንገለ፡ ጽንፈ፡ ሠለስቲሆሙ።
source.note: Selected Charles1906 printed64-66/PDF102+104. Current POB clips after ካልእ፡. Candidate restores the continuation before numbered 5 and corrects OCR ወካእእት to printed ወካልእት; exact source/English need independent scan review.

translation.text: And west of this was another mountain, lower than it and not high[a]. Beneath it, between them, was a valley, and another valley, deep and dry, toward the extremity of the three.[b]

footnotes.text: The height or extent expression remains under source review. “Not high” is provisional contextual wording, not a measurement.

The first valley is described as beneath it and between them; the second alone is expressly deep and dry. “The three” is understood as the three mountains; their precise spatial arrangement is not established here.
